description: Start here: identify the active workspace, read its purpose/architecture documents, Git state and index readiness. Optionally remember a declared task per project/session. Local only; never guesses user intent or chooses among multiple roots.

path.description: Explicit absolute workspace directory; otherwise use configured root or MCP client roots

project_name.description: Explicit indexed project; overrides automatic workspace selection

session_id.description: Use a distinct ID for each concurrent agent; default is shared

task.description: Current objective explicitly declared by the user/agent

name: workspace_context
